title: Children's dreams and the Firchlis
summary: Why children shape the Dreaming most.

claims.text: Young children sometimes glimpse chimerical reality before reason sets in, and their dreams, freer of Banality and more primal, shape the Near Dreaming more than adult dreams do.

Some believe children are a chief cause of the shimmering Firchlis that sweeps through the Mythic Realms and rearranges the dreamscape; beauty survives even in the darkest reaches because children still believe in miracles.

title: The Seas of Dream
summary: The oceans of the Near Dreaming.

claims.text: The Near Dreaming has oceans that mirror the waking seas; somewhere in their depths Atlantis still rests, merfolk make their homes, great leviathans sleep, and cities float beneath the waves, some thriving, some long empty.
One sunken city lies beyond reach of even the most gifted; some sidhe swear it resembles Arcadia in every way.
